description: The one floating menu of the Notion package. Desktop is an anchored popover; mobile is the core sheet. Title and footer render only in the sheet.

parameters.name: Footer
parameters.description: Footer rendered in both the desktop popover and the mobile sheet. A host that only wants it on the sheet must not also render the same action in ChildContent.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the core overlay changes the open state.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Forced layout. Auto reads the cascaded context.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised by Escape, an outside click and the sheet's Close button.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The sheet title. A desktop popover renders none.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name of the desktop popover. Defaults to Title (a desktop popover with no title needs an explicit value to stay a named dialog).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Viewport anchor coordinate of the zero-size anchor (a caret or a measured trigger).

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: See Top. Null anchors the menu where it renders in the DOM flow.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: The edge the popover opens from. The sheet presentation ignores it.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: The ARIA role of the panel (a dialog or a listbox menu).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the core overlay panel root.
